Meet the cook

Hi, I’m Nonna Joyce.

I’m a grandmother of five who loves bringing people together over a homemade meal. The recipes I share were shaped by my mother and my Italian mother-in-law, and every dish has a story.

Whether we’re making an old family favorite or trying something new, there’s always room for one more in the kitchen.
